<includeonly>==Purpose of template==

Select a quote of which [[{{#titleparts: {{{1}}} | 1 | 2 }}]] is the focus. If it's a person, they may be the speaker, or it may be in reference to them, or it may be in the prose of their POV. Otherwise, it may be a category to which the quote belongs.

==How to use==

 <nowiki>{{WotQ|</nowiki>{{#titleparts: {{{1}}} | 1 | 2 }}<nowiki>}}</nowiki>
 <nowiki>{{WotQ/</nowiki>{{#titleparts: {{{1}}} | 1 | 2 }}<nowiki>|</nowiki>''index''<nowiki>}}</nowiki>

''index'' is optional and must be a number between 1 and the total number of quotes this speaker has. See the source of [[Template:WotQ/{{#titleparts: {{{1}}} | 1 | 2 }}]] to see what that number is. If ''index'' is not provided, a quote will be selected randomly.
